messages:
alex_song: Heads up — I'm handing off in 30m. Planned deploy to prod tonight: v2.3.4. No active incidents but wanted to call out a couple of risks and the freeze window. :wave:
maria_chen: thanks alex. what time is the deploy scheduled for? do you need me to stay on for rollout? :eyes:
alex_song: Deploy starts 21:30 UTC, canary 10% -> 50% -> 100% over ~20m. Freeze window 21:00-23:00 UTC (no infra changes). Would appreciate you as primary watcher for the first 40m after 100% if possible.
devin_k: adding myself as backup watcher during the 22:00 spike runbook. will monitor metrics and tracer dashboard.
jess_p: I'll be on call for database side checks during migration step. note: there's a non-blocking index add on users table (online index) that may cause IO bump for ~2-3m at initial build. keep an eye on DB replica lag. :warning:
oncall-bot: Reminder: PagerDuty rotation switch scheduled at 22:00 UTC. If an alert triggers, follow the standard escalation: 1) current oncall -> 2) primary -> 3) infra oncall.
alex_song: rollback plan: deploy tag v2.3.3 is ready, rollback script is run/deploy/rollback.sh --tag v2.3.3. If we see error rates >5% for 5m or latency p95 > 1.5s, trigger rollback and ping infra channel.
samir_r: quick question — are there any model-serving changes with this version that impact memory config? I can pre-warm nodes if needed.
alex_song: good call. v2.3.4 toggles a small change to batch sizing in the runtime for embeddings; we've tested on staging but it could increase GPU mem temporarily during warmup. samir, please watch memory and pre-warm two nodes in eu-west if you can.
maria_chen: I can stay until 23:00 UTC and will be the primary watcher. I'll post a short status update at 21:45 and again at 22:15 after canary.
devin_k: I'll set up a Grafana watch and a slack alert (infra-alerts) for error-rate threshold. will also keep an eye on request per second.
jess_p: DB replica lag alert added. If lag > 30s, escalate to DBA team (ping @dba-team).
alex_song: handing off detailed notes: 1) pre-checks: run `./deploy/checks.sh` and confirm 0 failing health checks. 2) kick canary: `./deploy/run_canary --version v2.3.4 --percent 10`. 3) after 10m, bump to 50 then 100. 4) verify logs for 5xx and uptraces rate. 5) watch DB lag and GPU mem for warmup.
maria_chen: got it. any special customer-facing features to watch?
alex_song: No feature flags exposed; mostly infra/perf tuning. Only user-visible risk is slight latency bump during warmup for embeddings endpoints. Communicate if it persists >15m.
maria_chen: ok I'll ping #customer-facing if something customer-visible appears.
oncall-bot: Audit note: deploy v2.3.4 initiated by alex_song at 2025-09-02T21:30:00Z (simulated).
samir_r: pre-warm done for eu-west (2 nodes). memory looks steady on staging.
maria_chen: 21:45 status: canary healthy (10%), no 5xx, p95 within expected. bumping to 50% now.
jess_p: DB lag peaked at 12s during index job, back to <5s.
devin_k: Grafana alert test ok. watch dashboards are green.
maria_chen: 22:00 update: bumped to 100%, watching. no customer-visible issues so far. I'll stay until 23:00 then handback to rotation.
alex_song: thanks all — leaving notes in the oncall doc under /handovers/2025-09-02-v2.3.4.txt. Ping me if anything weird. :thumbsup:
